title: Events, PK and posters
sub: We keep the room exciting — PK battles, seasonal parties, and go-live nights. Exact dates live in the WhatsApp group.

items.title: Got talent? Got time?
items.imageAlt: Animated hosts pointing at the camera: Got talent? Got time? We dey find you.
items.text: If you can talk, sing, dance, cook, pray or just keep people company, there is a place for you at Roxy.

items.title: Bring your people
items.imageAlt: Roxy BC host referral promo poster with WhatsApp number.
items.text: Invite friends and family. Millions of people are on the app; we guide you for your own growth and visibility.

items.title: Seasonal events
items.imageAlt: Merry Christmas from Roxy BC poster.
items.text: Christmas and other seasons are a chance for fun events and gifts from friends around the world — an opportunity, not a guarantee.
